A '''Wookiee remembrance bracelet''' was a type of interwoven bracelet. A number of them were owned by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] that lived in the village [[Kiirloor]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[From the Trees]]'', if the player characters save Kiirloor from being destroyed by the [[Wyrd]], then the Wookiees give them some Wookiee remembrance bracelets as tokens of their appreciation.
